title: Rejewski ROE Consent Record (v2 — durable long-term archive)
description: Superset of the v1 replay-log-embedded consent record (schemas/roe-consent/v1.json). v2 keeps the entire v1 core unchanged so the same record can still seed a run's replay log, and adds the durable-archive block needed for a standalone consent artifact that reconciles field-by-field against the SharePoint ROE Consent Archive workbook (see docs/external-auth.md §5). v1 records (R010/R011) do NOT validate against v2 by design — they remain v1 and validate against v1.json; committed evidence is not invalidated. Self-test runs populate the counterparty block with an explicit self-test marker (never blank). additionalProperties: false throughout; draft 2020-12.

schema_version.description: Distinguishes a v2 durable-archive record from the v1 embedded shape (which carries no schema_version).

run_id.description: Binds the record to a run's replay-log entries (v1 core).

tenant_id.description: Target tenant GUID (v1 core). For engagement.type=self_test this MUST equal the G-1 sandbox tenant. For third_party_assessment it is the counterparty tenant — recorded here as authorization metadata only; G-1 still locks all actual Rejewski code execution to the sandbox today (docs/external-auth.md §2).

operator_object_id.description: Entra ID object id of the signed-in operator (v1 core); never UPN/display name.

techniques.description: ATT&CK technique IDs confirmed at the prompt (v1 core). MUST be a subset of scope.surface's agreed technique classes for a third-party engagement.

prompt_emitted_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp when the prompt was emitted (v1 core).

confirmed_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp when the operator confirmed (v1 core).

type.description: Workbook column: Engagement Type. self_test = cloudharbordemo/CHC-internal; third_party_assessment = an external counterparty tenant.

mvp_pillar.description: Workbook column: MVP Pillar (e.g. 'Pillar 2 - Security ROI').

is_self_test.description: Explicit self-test marker (AC4). TRUE for cloudharbordemo/CHC-internal runs; FALSE for a third-party engagement. Never omitted, never null.

org.description: Workbook column: Counterparty Org. Self-test runs use an explicit marker such as 'Cloud Harbor Consulting (self-test)', never blank.

surface.description: Workbook column: Scope Surface. The agreed, enumerated surfaces the run is authorized to touch (tenants, Graph surfaces, or technique classes). A third-party run MUST NOT exceed this set (docs/external-auth.md §3).

summary.description: Workbook column: Scope Summary — the plain-language statement of what was agreed.

signed_by_provider.description: Workbook column: Signed By (provider side) — the Cloud Harbor Consulting signatory.

signed_by_counterparty.description: Workbook column: Signed By (counterparty side). For a self-test this restates the CHC signatory (self-authorized).

signature_method.description: Workbook column: Signature Method. Free text to reconcile against the workbook's own vocabulary; recommended values: 'self_test_attestation', 'wet_signature', 'e_signature', 'email_authorization'. A third-party engagement MUST use a counter-signed method, not self_test_attestation (docs/external-auth.md §2).

expiry_date.description: Authorization expiry (YYYY-MM-DD). A run whose confirmed_at falls outside [effective_date, expiry_date] is out of authorization (docs/external-auth.md §3).

evidence_ref.description: Path or URI to the retained signed engagement-letter equivalent (the evidence that proves authorization). For a self-test this points at docs/roe-consent-flow.md.

record_id.description: Stable durable-record id (kebab-case, roe- prefix), independent of any single replay log.

storage_location.description: Workbook column: Storage Location — where the durable record and its evidence are filed.

created_utc.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp when this durable-archive record was authored.
